easy.def: Bits of meat or vegetables cooked on a stick.
examples: We ate a kebab.
The kebab is on a stick.
Dad grilled a kebab.

more.def: Pieces of meat or vegetables cooked on a long stick.
examples: Dad grilled kebabs with peppers and onions.
The vegetable kebab was colorful.
We ate kebabs on the porch.

easy.def: The long piece along the bottom of a boat.
examples: The keel keeps the boat steady.
The boat's keel is wood.
A keel is under the boat.

more.def: The long beam along the bottom of a boat that helps it stay steady.
examples: The keel keeps the sailboat from tipping over.
The keel of the old boat was made of oak.
A heavy keel helps a boat sail straight.

easy.def: Wanting to do something very much.
examples: I am keen to learn to swim.
He is keen on trains.
She is a keen reader.

more.def: Very interested and eager; also, sharp or strong.
examples: Owls have keen eyesight for hunting at night.
The dog has a keen sense of smell.
He is a keen gardener who grows his own vegetables.

easy.def: In a very interested way.
examples: He watched keenly.
She listened keenly.
The cat looked keenly at the bird.

more.def: In a sharp, eager way that shows great interest.
examples: The cat watched the bird keenly.
She listened keenly to every word of the story.
He was keenly interested in space.

easy.def: To have something and not give it away.
examples: You can keep the book.
She keeps her toys here.
I kept the ticket.

more.def: To have something and not lose it or give it away, or to store it somewhere.
examples: You can keep the pencil, because I have another one.
We keep the flour in a jar in the cupboard.
He kept every card his friends gave him.

easy.def: To stay in the same way.
examples: Keep warm.
Please keep still.
She keeps smiling.

more.def: To stay in a certain state, or to continue doing something.
examples: A thick coat will keep you warm on the snowy hike.
The little bird kept singing all morning long.
Please keep quiet while the baby sleeps.

easy.def: A person who takes care of something.
examples: The zoo keeper fed the lions.
The keeper watched the sheep.
A goal keeper.

more.def: A person whose job is to look after or guard something.
examples: The zookeeper fed the lions.
The lighthouse keeper lit the lamp.
The goalkeeper blocked the shot.

easy.def: A thing you keep to remember someone.
examples: The ring is a keepsake.
Grandma gave me a keepsake.
I keep the keepsake safe.

more.def: A small gift or object kept to remember someone or something special.
examples: Grandma's ring is a keepsake from our trip.
I keep a seashell as a keepsake of the beach.
The locket was a keepsake from her mother.

easy.def: A big brown seaweed.
examples: Kelp grows in the sea.
Otters rest in kelp.
The kelp is long.

more.def: A large brown seaweed that grows in thick underwater forests.
examples: Sea otters wrap themselves in kelp so they do not drift away.
Fish hide among the tall kelp.
Kelp can grow a foot in a single day.

easy.def: A small house or a place for dogs.
examples: The dog sleeps in the kennel.
A kennel in the yard.
We left our dog at the kennel.

more.def: A small shelter for a dog, or a place where dogs are kept and cared for.
examples: The dog slept in its kennel in the yard.
We left our dog at a kennel while we were on vacation.
The kennel has big runs for the dogs to play.

easy.def: A small scarf for the head or neck.
examples: She wore a kerchief.
The kerchief is red.
A kerchief covers hair.

more.def: A square of cloth worn tied over the head or around the neck.
examples: The girl wore a red kerchief around her neck.
Grandma tied a kerchief over her hair.
He wiped his face with a kerchief.

easy.def: One seed of corn.
examples: I ate a kernel.
A kernel of corn is yellow.
The kernel popped.

more.def: A seed of corn, or the soft part inside a nut.
examples: A kernel of corn popped in the pan.
We took the kernels off the cob.
The kernel is inside the hard shell of the nut.

easy.def: A fuel oil used in lamps and heaters.
examples: Old lamps burned kerosene.
The kerosene is oil.
Kerosene smells strong.

more.def: A thin oil that is burned in lamps, heaters and some engines.
examples: Long ago, lamps burned kerosene for light.
Jet engines use a fuel called kerosene.
The old lantern needed more kerosene.

easy.def: A red sauce for fries.
examples: I put ketchup on my fries.
The ketchup is red.
Pass the ketchup.

more.def: A thick, red sauce made from tomatoes that is eaten with foods such as fries.
examples: I put ketchup on my burger.
The bottle of ketchup was empty.
He dipped his fries in ketchup.

easy.def: A pot with a spout for heating water.
examples: The kettle is hot.
Mom filled the kettle.
The kettle whistled.

more.def: A metal pot with a lid, a handle and a spout, used for boiling water for tea and other things.
examples: The kettle began to whistle as the water started to boil.
Grandpa filled the kettle and put it on the stove.
Steam poured out of the spout of the kettle.

easy.def: A big, bowl-shaped drum.
examples: The kettledrum boomed.
A kettledrum is round.
The kettledrum is big.

more.def: A large, bowl-shaped drum with a skin stretched over the top.
examples: The kettledrum boomed in the orchestra.
A kettledrum is shaped like a bowl.
The percussionist tapped the kettledrum.

easy.def: A small metal tool for opening a lock.
examples: I lost my house key.
The key opens the door.
Dad has the car key.

more.def: A small metal object that you turn to open or lock something.
examples: She turned the key and the door swung open.
Dad keeps the keys to the car on a hook.
The old chest had a small brass key.

easy.def: A button you press on a piano or computer.
examples: Press the key.
The piano has black keys.
I pressed a key on the computer.

more.def: One of the parts you press on a piano, a typewriter or a computer.
examples: He pressed each key on the piano and listened.
Press the space key to start the game.
The cat walked across the keys of the keyboard.

easy.def: Very important.
examples: Practice is key.
A key idea is in the first line.
Teamwork is key for a good game.

more.def: Most important; needed in order to succeed.
examples: Sunlight is a key part of how plants make food.
The key idea in the story is friendship.
Practice is key if you want to get better at the piano.

easy.def: The keys you press on a computer or piano.
examples: I type on the keyboard.
She plays the keyboard.
The keyboard has many keys.

more.def: The set of keys that you press to type on a computer or to play music on a piano or an electronic instrument.
examples: I typed my story on the computer keyboard.
She played a tune on the keyboard in music class.
The piano keyboard has black and white keys.

easy.def: A ring or chain that holds keys.
examples: My keys are on a keychain.
The keychain has a toy.
I lost my keychain.

more.def: A ring or chain that holds keys together.
examples: My keys hang on a keychain.
The keychain has a little toy on it.
She clipped the keychain to her backpack.

easy.def: The hole in a lock where the key goes.
examples: He looked in the keyhole.
The key fits the keyhole.
The keyhole is small.

more.def: The hole in a lock where a key is put.
examples: She put the key into the keyhole and turned it.
A tiny keyhole in the old chest needed a small key.
He peeked through the keyhole of the door.

easy.def: A small set of buttons you press.
examples: Type on the keypad.
The keypad has numbers.
I pressed the keypad.

more.def: A small set of buttons or keys, such as on a phone or door lock.
examples: Type the code on the keypad.
The phone has a keypad with numbers.
The door has a keypad lock.

easy.def: The top stone in an arch.
examples: The keystone holds the arch.
A keystone is at the top.
The keystone is stone.

more.def: The wedge-shaped stone at the top of an arch that locks the other stones in place.
examples: The keystone holds the arch together.
If you remove the keystone, the arch falls.
The keystone sat at the very top.

easy.def: An important word that helps you find something.
examples: Type a keyword.
The keyword helps you search.
Use a keyword.

more.def: A word that is important or used to search for information.
examples: Type a keyword into the search box.
The keyword helped me find the book.
Underline the keywords in the paragraph.
